newsitem.title: USA: TVA, three public utilities form alliance.
newsitem.headline: TVA, three public utilities form alliance.

text.p: The Tennessee Valley Authority and three public power companies on Wednesday said they formed a Public Power Alliance that will foster ideas of mutual interest among public generation and transmission electric utilities.
TVA Chairman Craven Crowell announced the Alliance at a news conference in Chattanooga.
Alliance members are the TVA, Municipal Electric Authority of Georgia, Municipal Energy Agency of Mississippi, and Old Dominion Electric Cooperative.
The TVA said Alliance members will benefit by sharing cost savings, exchanging information, and assisting each other with operational, administrative and business products and services.
"The key benefits for Alliance members are greater leverage and a stronger competitive position in the deregulated energy marketplace of the future, Crowell said.
